label: build F1 1/5
result:
F1 unit 1 (ui.css foundations) is finished and committed on `v2/f1`, and HEAD is detached so the branch is free. The flow test prints "all good".

**Commit:** `383c755` "ui.css foundations: the v2 header, every status, level and theme token, base and print". Only `/Users/workingmyassof/satbank/.claude/worktrees/wf_d6beb6e4-66c-1/web/assets/ui.css` changed.

**What's in it:**
- **Header comment:** it restates the §2.1 rules, including product.md's changes to rules 1, 5, 8, 10 and 12 and its new rules 13–15. It also documents the token contracts that later units build on: states, levels, theme and print.
- **Question states (§2.3, R20, R35, R52, SR25):** an element sets `data-status` and reads the tokens `--st-fill`, `--st-bg`, `--st-edge`, `--st-edge-style`, `--st-fg`, `--st-halo`, `--st-glyph`, `--st-mark`, `--st-badge` and `--st-flag`. The values match the API's own status names so JS can copy them straight across: correct, incorrect, mixed, repaired, fixed, unanswered/blank, skipped, voided, removed (⊖), repeat, not_reached, answered, plus the type states unmet, met and ready.
  - Overlays: `data-filtered` fades to 30%, `--ring` is the current ring and `--hatch` means "being fixed". The flag notch turns ink on orange cells so it stays visible.
  - The tokens don't draw cells themselves. `.cell`, `.strip` and `.legend` do that.
- **Difficulty:** `--lvl-easy`, `--lvl-med` and `--lvl-hard` each have a text colour. `data-tier="easy|medium|hard"` gives `--lvl`, `--lvl-ink`, `--lvl-letter` (E, M, H) and `--lvl-n` (bars filled). The mastery bar reads `--m-track` and `--m-fill`.
- **Themes:** light stays the default. The Shell §2.13 dark tokens sit under `:root[data-theme="dark"]` inside `@media screen`, so a dark page prints light. New tokens in both themes: `--on-ink`, `--track`, `--backdrop`, `--shadow-pop`, `--radius`, `--radius-card`, `--card-pad` (16px on a phone) and `--touch`.
  - I chose the dark difficulty tints myself because the spec only gives light values: `#4A3219`, `#8A500B` and `#F18508`.
- **Text size and motion:** `data-text="small"` and `"large"` set `--q-size` and `--q-opt` (17/15.5, 20/18.5, 23/21), and `.q-stem` and `.opt` now use them. `data-motion="reduce"` behaves like the system reduced-motion setting. Page changes fade `main` for 120 ms (G9), with `#bar`, `#tabs` and `.side` held still above it; reduced motion turns this off.
- **Base elements:** orange native checkboxes and radios, tables, fieldset, hr, kbd/code, mark, bare links, text selection, dialog and backdrop, a `.skip` "Skip to content" link, and `.mono`.
- **Print:** the shell, overlays, controls and every button are hidden, and state fills print exactly. Rows and figures never split, and table headers repeat on each page. Page helpers: `.no-print`, `.print-only`, `.page-break`, `.keep`, and `button.print-keep` for a button that must stay.
- **Restyled, not renamed:** `.mbar`, `dialog.sheet` and `.calc` now read tokens; the old sheet backdrop rule is replaced by the base `dialog::backdrop`.

**Checks:**
- Before and after screenshots of all 11 ui.css pages at 1280 and 390 are the same. The only differences are Me's random device code and 136 anti-aliased pixels on Practice.
- There are no new console errors. The two 404s on the report and session pages come from my placeholder ids and happened before the change too.
- A scratch assertion script (`tokcheck.py`, in the session scratchpad) checks the tokens in light, dark, small, large, print and reduced motion. Dark renders of real pages look right.

**Needed from other owners:**
- **F2:** the avatar colour `#8A847C` in `ui.js` (line 278) should become `var(--soft)`. The `theme-color` meta should follow the theme. The skip link should use the `.skip` class and focus `main#main[tabindex=-1]`.
- **S1:** `web/me/index.html` line 68 passes `'#8A847C'` to `UI.mark` for the avatar; it should be `var(--soft)`.
- **S4:** `web/practice/index.html` lines 93 and 115 hard-code `rgba(63,63,63,.45)` and `rgba(255,255,255,0)`, which look wrong in dark.
- **S5:** `web/test/` has 47 hard-coded colours and doesn't load ui.css (R32).
- **S3:** `/` already scrolls sideways at 390px (scrollWidth 471) on master, before this change.
- **Print:** every button is hidden on paper, so the Practice builder, which is all buttons, prints blank. Pages whose content rows are `<button>` elements should add `.print-keep`.

**Left for later F1 units:** the component classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.cell`, `.legend`, `.dbars`, the shell classes and the rest), kit.js, charts.js, the 404 page and `web/dev/kit.html`.
- The page-change fade is named on `#bar`, `#tabs` and `.side`. If the components unit gives the page-level tabs control the class `.tabs`, it must not also take that name: two elements with the same name make the browser skip the fade.
